description: Speech to text / audio transcription: transcribe up to 60 seconds or 10 MB of audio with Google Cloud Speech-to-Text and get the transcript with its confidence and detected language. Use it for voice notes, call snippets and clips. Input: audio_base64; optional language_code. Longer audio is refused before payment. $0.25 per call.
